lemmas.name: L1 enumeration rule
lemmas.table_row: eq, in, max, glob, any (child is eq/in)
lemmas.statement: If the parent accepts every value in the child's allow-list T, then no value is in T and rejected by the parent. The parent predicate is an arbitrary function of the value and T is an arbitrary set.

lemmas.name: L1a parent eq a, child eq a
lemmas.statement: The same single value on both sides: v equals a and v does not equal a.

lemmas.name: L1b parent in S, child in T, T subset of S
lemmas.statement: T is a subset of S (sets of any size; a child eq a is T = {a}), v is in T and v is not in S.

lemmas.name: L1c parent max m, child eq/in with all values <= m
lemmas.statement: Every value in T is a number <= m (m any real), v is in T and v is not a number <= m.

lemmas.name: L1d parent glob g, child eq/in with all values matching g
lemmas.statement: Every value in T is a string matching g, v is in T and v is not a string matching g. The language of g is an arbitrary set of strings, so this holds for every pattern, not only prefix patterns.

lemmas.name: L1e a star-free glob g accepts exactly the string g
lemmas.statement: A string t on which membership in toolgate.smt.glob_regex(g) and t == g disagree, for a pattern g that contains no star. A regex cannot be built from a symbolic pattern, so this is checked for fixed g only. Together with L1 (the enumeration rule for an arbitrary parent predicate, taking T = {g}) this covers rule A: a child glob with no star is accepted exactly when the parent accepts the string g.

lemmas.name: L2 parent max m, child max n, n <= m
lemmas.statement: n <= m, v is a number <= n, and v is not a number <= m. Over the reals, which contain every Python int and finite float exactly.

lemmas.name: L3 parent glob g, child glob g
lemmas.statement: The same pattern on both sides (its language is an arbitrary set of strings): v matches and v does not match.

lemmas.name: L4 parent glob P*, child head starts with P
lemmas.statement: The child pattern is p0*p1*...*pk and its head p0 starts with P. v is a string p0 x1 p1 ... xk pk (so the child matches it) that does not start with P. P, every literal piece and every star's text are symbolic strings.
lemmas.bound: one query per number of child stars k = 0..4; strings of any length

lemmas.name: L4a a match starts with the child's head
lemmas.statement: t = p0 followed by anything (the rest of the match, for any number of stars), and t does not start with p0.

lemmas.name: L4b prefix is transitive
lemmas.statement: p0 starts with P, t starts with p0, and t does not start with P. With L4a this is the prefix rule for any number of stars.

lemmas.name: L4c the model's regex for P* means 'starts with P'
lemmas.statement: A string t on which membership in toolgate.smt.glob_regex(P + '*') and PrefixOf(P, t) disagree. A regex cannot be built from a symbolic pattern, so this is checked for fixed P only.

lemmas.name: L5 parent any, child anything
lemmas.statement: The parent accepts every value. v is accepted by an arbitrary child predicate and rejected by the parent.

lemmas.name: L6 capability composition (covers)
lemmas.statement: Same tool, the two capabilities name the same set of arguments, and every parent constraint has some child constraint on the same argument that implies it. A call the child capability permits and the parent capability refuses.
lemmas.bound: calls over 3 argument names; at most 3 constraints per capability; which argument each constraint is on is symbolic; each constraint's predicate is an arbitrary function of the value

lemmas.name: L7 grant composition (check_attenuation)
lemmas.statement: Every child capability is covered by some parent capability (covered means: whatever it permits, the parent capability permits) and the child expires no later than the parent. A call and a time at which the child grant allows and the parent grant does not.
lemmas.bound: at most 3 capabilities per grant; 'permits' is an arbitrary relation; times are reals

lemmas.name: L7a grant composition, any number of capabilities
lemmas.statement: Every capability in the child grant has a covering capability in the parent grant (the derivation). Some child capability permits a call that no parent capability permits.

lemmas.name: L7b expiry
lemmas.statement: child_expires <= parent_expires, now < child_expires, and not now < parent_expires. Over the reals.

lemmas.name: L8 budget is preserved along a chain (inductive step)
lemmas.statement: mid is within root's budget and leaf is within mid's budget, and leaf is not within root's budget. Budgets are integers or 'no limit'. With the base case (root is within its own budget) this is induction over a chain of any length.

lemmas.name: L8a budget along an unrolled chain
lemmas.statement: Each hop is within the previous hop's budget, and the last hop is not within the first hop's budget.

wrong_variants.name: W1 max with n >= m
wrong_variants.statement: Accept child max n when n >= m instead of n <= m.

wrong_variants.name: W2 prefix rule reversed
wrong_variants.statement: Accept child p0*p1 when P starts with p0 (the child's head is SHORTER than the parent's prefix) instead of p0 starting with P.

wrong_variants.name: W3 prefix rule applied to a parent P*Q
wrong_variants.statement: Apply the prefix rule to a parent pattern P*Q that has a literal tail, looking only at P.
wrong_variants.bound: parent with one star, child pattern with one star

wrong_variants.name: W4 glob_regex(P) read as 'starts with P'
wrong_variants.statement: Membership in glob_regex('reports/') (no star) and PrefixOf('reports/', t) disagree on some t.

wrong_variants.name: W5 sets intersect instead of subset
wrong_variants.statement: Accept child in T under parent in S when T and S share a value.
wrong_variants.counterexample: s1 = B(True); s2 = N(2); t1 = B(False); t2 = B(True); v = B(False)

wrong_variants.name: W6 child any under parent max
wrong_variants.statement: Accept child any under parent max m.

wrong_variants.name: W7 argument-name sets not required equal
wrong_variants.statement: covers() without the arg_names equality: the child may constrain an argument the parent never mentions.
wrong_variants.bound: calls over 3 argument names; at most 3 constraints per capability; which argument each constraint is on is symbolic; each constraint's predicate is an arbitrary function of the value
wrong_variants.counterexample: call(arg1 = S("B"), arg2 = S("A")); parent constraints: none; child constraints: child_pred_0 on arg2 (holds: True), child_pred_1 on arg1 (holds: True), child_pred_2 on arg2 (holds: True)

wrong_variants.name: W8 constraint quantifiers swapped
wrong_variants.statement: covers() asking that every CHILD constraint implies some parent constraint on its argument, instead of every parent constraint being implied by some child constraint. Argument names still equal.
wrong_variants.bound: calls over 3 argument names; at most 3 constraints per capability; which argument each constraint is on is symbolic; each constraint's predicate is an arbitrary function of the value
wrong_variants.counterexample: call(arg0 = S("A"), arg2 = S("")); parent constraints: parent_pred_0 on arg0 (holds: False), parent_pred_1 on arg2 (holds: True), parent_pred_2 on arg0 (holds: True); child constraints: child_pred_0 on arg2 (holds: True), child_pred_2 on arg0 (holds: True)

wrong_variants.name: W9 expiry check dropped
wrong_variants.statement: check_attenuation without 'child expires no later than parent'.
wrong_variants.counterexample: now = 0; child_expires = 1; parent_expires = 0; child capabilities: child_cap_2 (permits the call: True); parent capabilities: parent_cap_0 (permits the call: True), parent_cap_2 (permits the call: True)

wrong_variants.name: W10 capability coverage dropped
wrong_variants.statement: check_attenuation with only the expiry comparison.
wrong_variants.counterexample: now = -1/2; child_expires = 0; parent_expires = 0; child capabilities: child_cap_2 (permits the call: True); parent capabilities: none

wrong_variants.name: W11 unlimited child budget under a limited parent
wrong_variants.statement: Compare budgets only when both are limited, so a child with max_calls=None passes under a parent with a limit.

wrong_variants.name: W12 a glob with a star read as one literal string
wrong_variants.statement: Apply rule A to the pattern 'a*', which has a star: a string t that the pattern accepts and that is not the string 'a*' itself.
